purpose: Capture-time reference for the cross-layer diagnostic, NOT canaries. A canary asserts a verdict; these assert the score this direction produced on the activations it was fitted on, so a live run can be compared against them layer by layer. Measured by notebooks/qwen38_colab.ipynb on 2026-11-02, A100 80GB bf16, through transformers.
note: Served under vLLM the same prompts scored +0.02 to +0.05. Whether some OTHER vLLM layer reproduces the values below is the open question: if one does, transformers L39 is not vLLM L39 and no re-capture is needed. See kits/qwen38/MANIFEST.json known_gaps.
